question: The Padma Shri awardee Guru K Kalyanasundaram Pillai, the man who is keeping an ancient tradition alive,was awarded the Padma Shri 2023 for his contribution to the field of ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Bharatanatyam**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Guru K Kalyanasundaram Pillai** is a renowned exponent of Bharatanatyam, a classical dance form originating from Tamil Nadu.
 
• He has dedicated his life to preserving and promoting the ancient tradition of Bharatanatyam.
 
• In recognition of his significant contributions to this art form, he was awarded the **Padma Shri** in 2023.
 
• Bharatanatyam is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork, along with expressive hand gestures and facial expressions.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
